name: Install a CRD and use a custom resource
objective: CKA › Cluster Architecture (extend the API). A CustomResourceDefinition teaches the apiserver a new kind; once Established, you create and manage custom resources like any built-in. Install a CRD, then create a custom resource of that new kind. This is the 'install an operator's CRDs, then drive it with CRs' skill.

questions.title: Install a CustomResourceDefinition
questions.teach:
A **CRD** registers a new API type. Key fields: `group`, `names` (kind/plural/singular), `scope` (`Namespaced`/`Cluster`), and `versions[]` each with `served`, `storage`, and an OpenAPI `schema`. Applying it makes the apiserver serve `kubectl get <plural>`.

**Gotcha:** the CRD `metadata.name` MUST be `<plural>.<group>`. After apply, the CRD needs a moment to reach `Established=True` before you can create CRs.
questions.prompt:
Install a **Namespaced** CRD for kind `Widget` in group `example.com`, version `v1`: plural `widgets`, singular `widget`, shortName `wd`, with a spec field `size` (string). The CRD's name must be `widgets.example.com`.

Target: CRD `widgets.example.com` exists and reaches condition `Established=True`.
questions.hint: `metadata.name: widgets.example.com`; `spec.group: example.com`; `spec.scope: Namespaced`; `spec.names: {kind: Widget, plural: widgets, singular: widget, shortNames: [wd]}`; one version v1 `served: true, storage: true` with `schema.openAPIV3Schema` of type object containing `spec.properties.size: {type: string}`.
questions.solution:
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata: { name: widgets.example.com }
spec:
  group: example.com
  scope: Namespaced
  names: { kind: Widget, plural: widgets, singular: widget, shortNames: [wd] }
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              size: { type: string }
YAML
kubectl get crd widgets.example.com

verification.description: CRD widgets.example.com Established (Namespaced, group example.com, v1)

questions.title: Create a custom resource
questions.teach:
Once the CRD is Established, custom resources use `apiVersion: <group>/<version>` and the CRD's `kind`. They live in a namespace (for Namespaced CRDs) and you manage them with normal `kubectl` verbs, including the shortName.

**Gotcha:** the CR's `apiVersion` is `example.com/v1` (group/version), NOT `v1`. Fields not in the CRD schema are rejected (structural schema).
questions.prompt:
In namespace `crd-learn`, create a `Widget` named `gadget` with `spec.size: large`.

Target: a Widget `gadget` exists in `crd-learn` with `spec.size == large` (visible via `kubectl -n crd-learn get wd`).
questions.hint: `apiVersion: example.com/v1`, `kind: Widget`, `metadata.name: gadget`, `spec.size: large`. Apply into namespace crd-learn.
questions.solution:
kubectl create namespace crd-learn 2>/dev/null
cat <<'YAML' | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: example.com/v1
kind: Widget
metadata: { name: gadget, namespace: crd-learn }
spec:
  size: large
YAML
kubectl -n crd-learn get widgets

verification.description: Widget gadget exists in crd-learn with spec.size=large
